gloss_en: Rain (גְּשָׁמִים, plural of גֶּשֶׁם) — the literal precipitation that waters the earth, formed from vapors rising from the ground and drawn down through the cloud and the honor/glory of God and the Torah; its withholding (עֲצִירַת גְּשָׁמִים) is a punishment. Not גַּשְׁמִי/גְּשָׁמִים in the sense of 'corporeal/material things' (physicality), nor the personal name Geshem.
